# Every `static native` method of the Java SDK's `FlzCore`, in declaration
# order, paired with the C ABI entry point it reaches: `<method>|<entry point>`.
#
# Java reaches the core through JNI, so its surface is two hand-written lists
# that no compiler compares: the class's declarations and `jni_glue.rs`'s
# exports. This file is the declared table both are held to: `flz_core_ffi`'s
# `veneer_jni.rs` asserts `FlzCore.java` and the JNI exports against it, and the
# Java SDK's `JniSurfaceTest` asserts the class declares exactly these methods,
# which is the assertion its own repository can run.
#
# Adding a native method: add the row, the export in `jni_glue.rs` and the
# declaration in `FlzCore.java`.
schemaVersion|flz_core_schema_version
contextNew|flz_core_context_new
declareClass|flz_core_declare_class
checkClass|flz_core_check_class
start|flz_core_start
localStart|flz_core_local_start
localOnSink|flz_core_local_on_sink
localFeed|flz_core_local_feed
localNextOutput|flz_core_local_next_output
localRunUntilIdle|flz_core_local_run_until_idle
localStop|flz_core_local_stop
poll|flz_core_poll
complete|flz_core_complete
waitStarvation|flz_core_wait_starvation
abandon|flz_core_abandon
spawnRequest|flz_core_spawn_request
spawnResult|flz_core_spawn_result
part|flz_core_part
adminCall|flz_core_admin_call
sendMessage|flz_core_send_message
relays|flz_core_relays
monotonicNanos|flz_core_monotonic_nanos
shutdown|flz_core_shutdown
contextFree|flz_core_context_free
